claims.claim: Hindsight is 20/20: Building Agent Memory that Retains, Recalls, and Reflects；2512.12818v1；版本日期 2025-12-14
会话记忆容易混淆事实、经历、归纳和判断。
将 world、experience、observation、opinion 分网，以 retain／recall／reflect 操作；记忆带实体和时间，检索结合语义、关键词、图及时间线索。
§7.3 检索预算仍有占位符；部分外部基线未重跑且 judge 不同，跨系统胜负不能视为严格匹配实验。未复现或审计代码。
LongMemEval-S 中作者报告同 OSS-20B 骨干从 39.0% 提升到 83.6%。

source_caveats.detail: §7.3 retrieval budgets are literally left as <add> tokens for both datasets.

§7.3 imports LongMemEval external baselines using their published GPT-4o judge; Hindsight uses GPT-OSS-120B judge. LoCoMo baselines are explicitly reported reference points, not independently reproduced by the authors.
